title: Amazing top habit app on app store
body: Although i had a paid subscription in another habit tracking app, i didnt like it much and there were some issues. But with this app, it is just wow! The only advice is to please add more and more stickers, or just allow us to add any sticker we have in our keyboard.
author: Princess_11111

title: I love this app ;D
body:
-it’s great for planning out you’re week or day 

-it’s also very aesthetically pleasing and Basic 

THE PROBLEM’S:

-it has some Japanese spellings in half of the app
+it’s kinda hard to understand at first 
BUT YOU’ll GET THERE  ;D
author: RiverCloud<3
